lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Hmm

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I don't know if I'm doing this right, but uh...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: What're you up to?
Just sitting and resting.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I didn't have anything in particular to say.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: You just said that I could message you anytime,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: so I thought I'd try it out.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Am I doing it right?
Are you really just messaging for no reason?
You sound so formal haha

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I do?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: This is the first time I've ever messaged someone without a specific purpose.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I'm still not used to it.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I don't really know what to say.
That's only natural if it's your first time.
Okay, then let's practice.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: So, I was wondering...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Could you help me out?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I want to practice having normal conversations.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: What should I do?
What did you eat today?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: What did I eat?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: That kinda came out of nowhere.
This is all part of practicing.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Oh, we're practicing.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I ate Splendamin today.
And...? You can't just stop there.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: What, did I leave something out?
If you only answer the question, the conversation won't continue.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I need to continue the conversation...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Okay, I think I got it.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I have to respond in a way that allows the other person to continue the conversation, right?
You catch on quick.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I'll try again, this time in a way that keeps the conversation going.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I ate Splendamin today.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: It was the gummy kind.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Have you tried it before?
Yeah, of course. I was surprised at how flavorless it was.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Oh, okay. So that's how you do it.
A normal conversation just involves bouncing off of what the other person says.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I think I've got a sense for it now.
It's just like having a conversation in person.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Yeah, I guess so.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Whether we talk over text,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: or in person,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: the only difference is really whether we speak or type.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: That was some good practice.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Next time I send you a message,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I'll be sure to remember what we practiced today.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Is there anything else you think I should work on?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I actually have to go now.
Sure, there's more we could work on.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Okay, then I hope you'll help me again later.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Would you mind?
Text me anytime.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: It feels like you're always helping me...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: All I can say is thank you so much.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I look forward to practicing more with you.
